description: This is a PHP class defining an exception named SyncInboundEmailAccountsEmptyException, which extends the base Exception class. It serves as a specific exception type within the SuiteCRM module related to synchronization of inbound email accounts, used to indicate an empty or missing inbound email account scenario.

classes.name: SyncInboundEmailAccountsEmptyException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending PHP's base Exception, used within SuiteCRM to signify an empty inbound email account condition.
